ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:12 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity field across both lobes. Localized high-intensity punctate clusters are concentrated along the lower trailing margins and within the distal tips. A high-contrast contiguous grey-white cluster is mapped at the extreme left and right tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with an estimated 45-degree interior angle at the vertex relative to the horizontal plane of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central trailing edge; high-amplitude, irregular jagged protrusions at the distal tips corresponding to external biological attachments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edge, sweeping upward and outward from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular high-contrast pixel clusters on the extreme distal tips; sparse individual white punctate spots distributed across the lower third of the ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct multi-directional linear grey-white pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the upper central region of the right lobe; sparse diagonal scratches on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biological colonization (barnacles) at both distal tips; distinct white linear rake marks on the surface of the right lobe.
